method: Canonical package.json path identifies a node. Required closure traverses dependencies + required peers. Existing optional peers enter a separate optional-expansion queue and recursively traverse their dependencies and both peer types. Per-directory/reachability scheduling handles cycles and duplicate arrivals without merging versions. A node may retain required and optional reachability; required membership takes precedence for requiredClosure.

definitions.requiredClosure: Only required-reachability nodes and edges; optional peers never enter this set.
definitions.directOptionalPeerTargets: Targets of installed optional-peer edges; includes targets also independently reached by required paths.
definitions.optionalTransitiveNodes: Optional-only nodes excluding directOptionalPeerTargets; descendants reached by recursive optional expansion.
definitions.completeRuntimePlusOptionalPeerGraph: Union of required closure and the complete optional peer expansion; optional expansion includes its required-peer and dependency descendants.
definitions.missingIndependentLicenseFile: No LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING file in the actual node package directory; not a claim of no license declaration.
